mentions.description: Meal planning app that generates no/low-touch weekly meal plans delivered to your inbox, built around meals from chefs you follow. Users can build a cookbook from chefs they follow on socials (YouTube) or import recipes from any source such as the web or a photo of a cookbook, with tight integration into recipe lists. GenAI is used to auto-extract recipes, manage unit conversions, merge and categorize shopping lists, and power the recommendations engine.

mentions.audience: Personal meal planning use, with beta testers invited

mentions.name: mealplannr.io
mentions.description: Web app that delivers no/low-touch weekly meal plans straight to your inbox, covering meal planning and shopping lists so home cooks can cook the meals they love without the hassle. Recipe discovery lets users build a cookbook from chefs they follow on socials (YouTube for now) or import recipes from any source (web pages or photos of cookbooks), with tight integration into recipe lists. GenAI is used to auto-extract recipes, manage conversions, merge and categorize shopping lists, and power the recommendations engine. Currently seeking beta testers.
mentions.problem: Planning meals and compiling shopping lists takes the author hours every week; the app removes that hassle by automating weekly meal plans and shopping lists.
mentions.audience: Home cooks who want weekly meal plans and shopping lists handled for them
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://mealplannr.io
The end game is no/low touch weekly meal plans send directly to your inbox, with meals you love to cook but with none of the hassle around planning the meals, shopping list etc (which I spend hours doing every week).

An important feature for me was improving the recipe discovery experience, you can build a cookbook from chefs you follow on socials (youtube for now), or import from any source (Web, or take pic of cookbook etc) - it then has tight / easy integration into recipe lists.

Utilising GenAI to auto extract recipes, manage conversions, merge/categorise shopping lists etc - as-well as the actual recommendations engine.
